title: Lawful signing and verification
environment: three demo databases: carejiox, carejiox_template, hhh; synthetic isolated tests on codex_vn2026
state: Implemented controls with scoped verification; independent review and remaining actions pending
implemented_controls: Internal clinician confirmation identifies the authenticated signer and preserves the content seal. Consent evidence PDF distinguishes drawn signatures from certified digital signatures. Integration readiness stores provider/specification/onboarding references.
remaining_actions: Select accredited CA/equivalent lawful mechanism, obtain approved signing profile, implement its driver and validate certificates/timestamps/revocation before a certified-signing claim.
limitations: Automated tests and demo evidence establish stated software behavior only. They do not establish every legal obligation, production suitability, authority acceptance or MPS certification.
